title: ITVX / Bus-side audience voices
slide_intent: Write a sequence of short audience identities to express breadth without a catalogue of titles, because language tells audiences whether a service speaks to them.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen audience identification with the service.
demonstration: A yellow panel on a red bus pairs the ITVX logo with stacked phrases including Crime junkie, Petrol head and Drama queen.
practical_value: Write a sequence of short audience identities to express breadth without a catalogue of titles.
